original_content_full:
The paper "Mining Developer Expertise from Bug Tracking Systems using the Author-Topic Model" by Daniel Atzberger, Jonathan Schneider, Willy Scheibel, Daniel Limberger, Matthias Trapp, and Jürgen Döllner was accepted for publication and presentation at the 17th International Conference on Evaluation of Novel Appraoches to Software Engineering. The conference will take place as virtual-only event between April 25-26, 2022.

This paper won the "Best Student Paper Award" of the ENASE 2022.
